subject: literacy
concept: Judging whether a source seems reliable versus questionable
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares two sample sources (one clearly credible, one clearly not) and discusses differences
exercise.pictorial: Student sorts source descriptions into 'trustworthy' and 'questionable' piles with reasons
exercise.abstract: Student explains why a given source is or isn't reliable for a research question

misconception_flags: judges reliability purely by how confident or professional the source sounds

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
